name: Sealed Bid Auction
summary: Private-value auction where bidders submit hidden bids, highest wins and pays first or second price.
rules_text: Each bidder receives a private valuation for the item, unknown to others. All bidders simultaneously submit a sealed numeric bid to the auctioneer without seeing others' bids. After all bids are collected, they are revealed. The highest bidder is declared the winner. In a procurement version, the lowest bidder wins. In a first-price rule, the winner pays their own bid and earns valuation minus bid. In a second-price rule, the winner pays an amount equal to the second-highest bid. Losers earn zero. If tied, winner is chosen randomly.
rating_reason: Classic sealed-bid auction, hidden bids, ranking winner
